args.text:
The batch has 8 runs (r01–r08), and all 8 were accepted.

Flagged: 1 run, r08, for check_failed_but_accepted.
- Its closure value is 2.899 against a threshold of 1.0, yet the record marks the check as passed. The tip motion from the midline and stage log doesn't match the tip motion from the tracked kinematics, so r08's velocity and strain-rate field can't be trusted.
- r08 was also reported with the width-free ratio (max 0.04), so plane sections was not run. Its summaries are in line with the batch.

Cleared: 7 runs (r01–r07).
- All three checks pass and there are no roll backs.
- The large z-scores come from a near-zero batch MAD, not from real differences. The REGR peak is 53.24 vs 53.1 %/h (z=18.89 on r01, r02 and r06), a gap of about 0.3%. r03's growth zone is 674 vs 684 µm, about 1.5% shorter.
- Peak position (421 µm), growth-zone length and flank difference all match the batch.

What the flagged runs have in common: there is only one flagged run, so there is no shared pattern. r08 is the only run that used the width-free ratio, and the one with the most steps (5). Its failed closure check suggests the tracked kinematics don't agree with the stage log.
